candidates.statement: Order service returns HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders, which the gateway surfaces as 502 on POST /v1/checkout. Traces and logs show the gateway's client call to order:8000 failing with 500 across all correlated requests.
candidates.uncertainty: Order-side logs/traces and dependency outcomes (inventory, payment, postgresql) are absent, so the internal cause of the order 500 is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Gateway 502s on /v1/checkout are explained by the order service returning 500 on /v1/orders, seen consistently in traces and gateway client logs. The proximate fault is bounded to the order service; its internal cause needs order-side evidence.
